Keep Skyservice Business Aviation Inc. as a separate related Canadian PortCo; do not copy its 2017 majority stake or Fund I ownership onto the U.S. record.

Do not infer the U.S. manager-level stake, co-investor cap table or acquisition vehicle.

Keep Kenmore, Exec Air Montana/Montana Medical Transport, airport sites, leases, hangars and later developments beneath Skyservice US.

recommendedNextAction: Prepare one later protected merge and redirect proposal from Skyservice US (formerly Leading Edge Jet Center) into Skyservice US, preserving the Canadian-parent boundary and corrected U.S. ownership and milestone facts.
